messages:
maria: hey team :wave: I'm setting up my laptop — where do I get a hosted API key vs the sandbox key? Also what's the default sandbox quota/rate-limit so I don't accidentally hit it during testing?

sam: welcome! hosted API keys are in Console -> Settings -> API Keys (org owners can create). Sandbox keys are issued automatically on signup and live in Console -> Sandbox. Hosted keys are billing-backed; sandbox keys have free credits and safety limits.

jonathan: quick notes: don't commit keys. set env var: REDWOOD_API_KEY

Example curl for sandbox:
```
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```

sam: Sandbox quotas: default free credit of $50 and ~100k tokens/month for new hires (may vary by promo), rate-limit ~10 reqs/sec per key with short burst allowance up to ~40. If you need more for load testing, ping #eng-sre or open a help ticket at go/redwood-help.

maria: ah ok — where do I request a sandbox bump? and who approves hosted keys for prod?

devex-bot: To request a quota bump, file in https://go/redwood-help (choose \"Sandbox quota increase\") or @mention eng-sre. Hosted prod keys require an org admin to create and usually a short security approval (manager + security). Email security@redwood.com if your work involves customer data access.

jonathan: Tip: for local dev heavy tests, prefer synthetic tokens or use a dedicated staging account to avoid burning sandbox credits. Also we have an internal script to rotate keys: `scripts/rotate_api_key.sh` — use that whenever you regenerate keys so services don't break.

maria: thanks! saved. tagging @sam for follow-up on access for my team.

sam: happy to help — I'll DM you a checklist and add you to the `dev-keys` group for quick access. :thumbsup:
